title: Backdoored model-gateway release reached agent frameworks downstream
purpose: Model-gateway routing for production agent applications
summary: A backdoored build of a popular model gateway sat on the package index for about three hours and was downloaded tens of thousands of times, pulling in an autonomous attack component. The tempo lesson matters: agent stacks pull dependencies far more often and with far less human presence, so a survivable three-hour window converts to mass installs.
disputed: Download figures from post-incident telemetry; share reaching running agent runtimes unestablished.

chain.BREACH: Malicious release published under a trusted package name.
chain.CHANNEL: Payload retrieved an autonomous attack component post-install.
chain.ESCALATE: Executed with the installing agent runtime's privileges.
chain.PROPAGATE: Tens of thousands of downloads across dependent frameworks in hours.
chain.HALT: Release pulled; downstream pinning and rebuilds required.
